name: sok-gesture-failure-without-window
description: A gesture without --window asks agent.surface, which refuses, and windows.list first. A gesture step that the host refuses with the error 1007 ends the command at that step; sok prints the step number, the message and the code, and sends no later step. The message is the one that the host builds for a press that the mask of the pressed buttons rejects.
reason: The refusal 1007 needs a press that another pointer holds, which the window check does not make on demand.

refusal.example: process 1 is not a process of a surface: no parent process of it is a running sidecar of the application that started it for a surface

error.message: AppKit reports NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons mask 0x1 while no application is frontmost; the synthetic press or release was not delivered
